scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,worker,frontend -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run worker" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,worker -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix backend run worker"
scripts.preview: npm run build && concurrently -n backend,worker,frontend -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix backend run worker" "npm --prefix frontend run preview -- --host 0.0.0.0"
